inicio.h1: The flavors of Loja's 16 cantons, in your kitchen
inicio.lead: Traditional dishes from the province, with their origin, source and review status in plain view, so you can cook, share and explore Loja with confidence.
aviso.texto: Recipes are not complete or validated yet: they are shown as “Sample content” until the knowledge holders review them.
inicio.cantones.intro: The province of Loja has 16 cantons, and each one keeps its own flavors.
inicio.recomendador.texto: Tell it which ingredients you have and what occasion you are cooking for. It will suggest recipes and explain why.
catalogo.intro: Traditional dishes grouped by the 16 cantons of the province of Loja.
catalogo.error: The recipes could not be loaded. If you opened the file by double-clicking it, use the local server (see the README) or reload the page.
mapa.etiqueta: Map of Loja's cantons. Each canton links to its traditional dish.
mapa.ayuda: Tap a canton on the map to see its traditional dish.
prox.recomendador.texto: This feature will arrive in a later stage of the prototype. It will run in your own browser, with no accounts or personal data, and every suggestion will come with the reason it is proposed.
prox.acerca.texto: This page will explain the purpose, the phased model, the methodology, the sources, the validation, the license and how artificial intelligence was used in this prototype.
pie.proyecto: Academic prototype of the Master's in Business Management (EDES, UTPL).
